# utils

`utils` groups Windows-oriented concurrency, command-line flags, executable-memory patching, filesystem and PE I/O, memory ownership, module introspection, string processing, and thread-management APIs.

## Contents

- [concurrency.hpp](./concurrency.hpp) — `container<T, MutexType>` synchronizes access to a default-constructed `T` through `access`, `access_with_lock`, and `get_raw`.
- [flags.cpp](./flags.cpp) — `parse_flags` and `has_flag` parse case-insensitive Windows command-line switches into cached `enabled_flags`.
- [flags.hpp](./flags.hpp) — `has_flag(const std::string&)` exposes flag lookup.
- [hook.cpp](./hook.cpp) — `detour`, `iat`, `nop`, `call`, `jump`, and `assemble` implement MinHook detours, IAT replacement, byte patching, relative branches, and AsmJit assembly.
- [hook.hpp](./hook.hpp) — `assembler`, `detour`, `set`, `invoke`, `get`, `nop`, `call`, `jump`, `is_relatively_far`, and `assemble` define runtime patching and typed memory APIs.
- [io.cpp](./io.cpp) — `remove_file`, `file_exists`, `write_file`, `read_file`, `read_pe_string_rva`, `file_size`, directory helpers, and `list_files` implement Windows filesystem and PE-string operations.
- [io.hpp](./io.hpp) — Declares the filesystem APIs exported by `io.cpp`.
- [memory.cpp](./memory.cpp) — `memory::allocator` tracks allocations, while `allocate`, `duplicate_string`, `free`, `is_set`, `is_bad_read_ptr`, and `is_bad_code_ptr` manage and validate process memory.
- [memory.hpp](./memory.hpp) — Defines `memory::allocator`, templated allocation helpers, pointer validation, and `get_allocator`.
- [nt.cpp](./nt.cpp) — `nt::library` loads, inspects, unprotects, and frees PE modules; `get_iat_entry`, `load_resource`, `relaunch_self`, `terminate`, and `raise_hard_exception` provide process integration.
- [nt.hpp](./nt.hpp) — Declares `nt::library`, export resolution through `get_proc` and `get`, invocation helpers, PE accessors, and process helpers.
- [string.cpp](./string.cpp) — `va`, `to_lower`, `to_upper`, prefix/suffix matching, conversion, `dump_hex`, `get_timestamp`, `match_compare`, and `get_clipboard_data` implement string utilities.
- [string.hpp](./string.hpp) — Defines `va_provider`, variadic formatting, case conversion, matching, encoding, timestamp, hex-dump, and clipboard interfaces.
- [thread.cpp](./thread.cpp) — `set_name`, `get_thread_ids`, `for_each_thread`, `suspend_other_threads`, and `resume_other_threads` manage Windows thread metadata and suspension.
- [thread.hpp](./thread.hpp) — Declares thread naming overloads, `create_named_thread`, enumeration, suspension, and resumption APIs.

## File Relationships

`flags.cpp` calls `string::to_lower`; `thread.cpp` calls `string::convert`; `string.hpp` obtains allocation services from `memory::get_allocator`; `hook.hpp` and `hook.cpp` use `nt::library` for IAT patching; `io.cpp` composes `create_directory` with `write_file` and `file_exists` with `read_file`, `file_size`, and `read_pe_string_rva`.

`hook.cpp` initializes MinHook through the static RAII class `_`; `detour::create`, `detour::enable`, `detour::disable`, and `detour::clear` govern hook lifecycle, while `place_` and `original_` track patch and trampoline addresses.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `parse_flags` strips leading `-`; `has_flag` lazily populates `enabled_flags` once through `parsed`.
- `call` emits opcode `0xE8`; `jump` emits opcode `0xE9`; both encode 5-byte signed 32-bit relative branches and throw `"Too far away to create 32bit relative branch"` when unreachable.
- `detour::create` throws `"Unable to create hook"` when `MH_CreateHook` fails; MinHook startup throws `"Failed to initialize MinHook"` when `MH_Initialize()` fails.
- `nop` writes `0x90` bytes; `set` and `nop` use `PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE`, restore protection, and call `FlushInstructionCache`.
- `read_pe_string_rva` validates `IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE`, positive `e_lfanew`, `IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE`, PE bounds, section ranges, raw offsets, null termination, and `max_length`; malformed or empty results return `std::nullopt`.
- `memory::is_bad_read_ptr` and `memory::is_bad_code_ptr` reject `PAGE_GUARD`, `PAGE_NOACCESS`, and failed `VirtualQuery`; readable and executable protection sets determine acceptance.
- `va_provider<Buffers, MinBufferSize>` rejects zero template parameters through `static_assert`, rotates reusable buffers, grows capacity by `double_size`, and throws `"String pool not initialized"` when unavailable.
- `get_timestamp` formats `%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S`; `dump_hex` emits uppercase `%02X` bytes separated by `separator`.
- `nt::raise_hard_exception` invokes `NtRaiseHardError` with status `0xC000007B`; `get_iat_entry` compares names case-insensitively with `_stricmp`.
- `get_clipboard_data` requires successful `OpenClipboard`, `GetClipboardData(1u)`, and `GlobalLock`; `thread::set_name` dynamically resolves `SetThreadDescription`.
- `read_file` sizes buffers through `uint32_t`, so files exceeding 32-bit size metadata can truncate allocation information.

## Windows Integration

`VirtualProtect`, `FlushInstructionCache`, `GetCurrentProcess`, `CommandLineToArgvW`, `GetCommandLineW`, `LocalFree`, `DeleteFileA`, PE image structures, `LoadLibraryA`, `FreeLibrary`, `GetProcAddress`, `CreateProcessA`, `TerminateProcess`, `VirtualQuery`, `SetThreadDescription`, and Toolhelp thread snapshots define the platform boundary for `utils`.
